verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-automation and web-fetch platform, so per-URL-pattern crawl configuration within a batch job is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents concurrent sessions, URL fetching and scheduled agents, but nothing describes batch crawl jobs or applying different configurations to different URL patterns. Building this from concurrent sessions would be a developer building block, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
